text:
Mike H: heads up — canary rollout prefetch routing (10%) is showing quota spikes + provisional charges on console for some customers. reproducible with streaming toolcalls.
Lara T: can you paste an example trace id? also which model/variant? prefetch routing == the new kv-prefetch policy?
Mike H: trace: trace/0a7f9c; model: redwood/open-x-1.0-q4; scenario: client streams, server toolcall returns early with 204 (no content), client reconnects, streaming resumes -> console shows both stream tokens and toolcall tokens billed.
Ian K: we saw a similar pattern but with sticky-routes + eviction. kv cache gets evicted during canary so resumed stream re-sends prefix -> double-charge for overlapped tokens.
Emma R: billing-bot reported 'provisional_charge' events for same request id. logs attached: `provisional_charge: request_id=0a7f9c amount=0.012` then later `final_charge: request_id=0a7f9c amount=0.012` — looks like provisional not being reconciled?
billing-bot: billing: provisional entries created for stream chunks with status=pending; finalization delayed by 30s due to fallback path. No automatic dedupe between provisional and final when toolcall boundary shifts.
Mike H: repro script: `curl -H 'x-trace:0a7f9c' -d @payload http://canary.api/stream` then kill client at chunk boundary, wait 5s, reconnect. Steps produce two billing rows.
Lara T: is this only when toolcall returns non-200? or any early termination?
Mike H: primarily when toolcall truncates response or returns 2xx empty. Also observed when reconnect triggers fallback to same route but different server instance (no kv prefix).
Ian K: short term: we could add dedupe key that combines request_id + sequence_prefix_hash and avoid double finalization if overlap > threshold. Longer term: adjust routing to honor cache ownership during rollouts.
Emma R: console UX: can we surface 'provisional' badge on per-request trace waterfall + link to billing provisional ledger? users confused why they're seeing charges while request still 'in-flight'.
Mike H: also quota enforcement: quota counter increments on provisional create; users hitting quota unexpectedly while provisional still pending.
Lara T: oh that's bad — provisional should be non-blocking for quota, or we need provisional placeholders that don't count toward soft quota. Which is safer?
Ian K: Safer to not count provisional towards quota; rely on final charges for hard quota enforcement. But that opens door to abuse with infinite create/destroy loops. Need TTL + conservative provisional cap.
Emma R: proposed console change: show provisional tokens separately and offer 'reclaim' button for admins to trigger reconciliation scan. Also expose metric `billing.provisional.pending` in dashboards.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered for rollout/kv-prefetch at 2026-03-20T10:12:31Z by lara.t due to quota-anomaly alerts.
Mike H: following rollback — canary incidence reduced. However we want a permanent fix. I'll open a ticket with implementation plan.
Lara T: add to eng-platform board: `prefetch-canary-billing-dedupe`. include reproducer, traces, proposed fixes: 1) dedupe key; 2) provisional-not-counted; 3) console indicators.
Ian K: I'll draft PR for dedupe logic. quick question: does telemetry capture `sequence_prefix_hash`? if not, add to stream envelope.
Mike H: no it's not captured consistently on current canary. I'll add capture in streamer before sending to router.
Emma R: thanks. also please add unit test for scenario with toolcall-empty -> reconnect -> resumed-chunk. want to ensure no double-finalization.
Mike H: :thumbsup: will do. ETA PR by EOD tomorrow.
